title: Croatian Flatbread with Sweet Juicy Topping
description: A delicious and easy-to-make flatbread topped with sweet and juicy ingredients. Perfect as a snack or light lunch.
instructions: Slice the Croatian flatbread into triangles or squares.
In a bowl, mix diced peaches, honey, and chopped mint.
Place the flatbread slices on a baking sheet.
Top each flatbread slice with a spoonful of the peach mixture.
If using feta cheese, sprinkle on top.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the flatbread is crispy.
Optional: grill the flatbread for a crispy crust.
